read.passage: Last weekend, Noura and her family visited her grandfather's farm in Al-Ahsa. The farm has more than two hundred palm trees, and her grandfather sells the dates at the market every Friday. Noura wanted to help him pick the dates, but the trees were too tall to climb, so she washed the boxes instead. In the evening, everyone sat outside and drank Arabic coffee. Noura's little brother was bored at first because there was no internet, but soon he started playing with the farm cats. Noura is going to visit the farm again in the winter holiday.

qs.q: Why didn't Noura pick the dates?
How did Noura's brother feel when he first arrived?
options: Happy, because he liked the cats
Bored, because there was no internet

speak.prompt: Tell me about a special day you enjoyed, for example Eid or a family trip. What did you do, who was with you, and why did you like it?
speak.expect: At A2+ the learner can give a short, simple description of a past event as a sequence of linked sentences (e.g. 'First we went to my grandmother's house, then we ate…'). They use the past simple of common regular and irregular verbs (went, ate, saw, bought), mostly accurately. They link ideas with and, but, because, then. They give a simple reason or opinion ('I liked it because I played with my cousins'). They use everyday vocabulary for family, food, places and feelings. Pauses, false starts and some errors are likely, but the meaning is clear. They can answer a simple follow-up question but cannot yet develop a detailed or extended narrative (B1).
